title: bupleurum tenuissimum subsp. eutenuissimum
intro: Bupleurum tenuissimum subsp. eutenuissimum, commonly known as Chinese thoroughwort, is a plant species in the Apiaceae family, traditionally used in herbal medicine. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving liver function, and alleviating symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Chinese thoroughwort include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties, which can help regulate the body's response to stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
